notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W7-Q01_4 railway level crossing short-stacking warning sign 'KEEP TRACK CLEAR' (roundabout beyond the crossing; 2023, page 4 of 7), fully dimensioned and drawn to scale, 1200 x 1400, R100. Upper part: yellow ground, yellow edge 10 + black border 10 (the sheet's 10 / 20); lower part from 1170 down: red with a white band 10 wide 10 in from the edge along the sides and bottom (the sheet's vectors), white legend 90 Series D. Right chain 75 / 1070 / 25 / 55 / 90D / 85 = 1400: legend cap top(s) [1225]; word gaps [44, 57] measured. Layout symbol (road, track, stacking arrows): the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-q01-4_layout.svg), placed as drawn: 900.0 x 1070.1 at x 150.0, y 75.0 (the sheet's chain dimensions describe this artwork). Distance: numeral 100 Series D in the dashed box (169 wide at x 195) and 'm' Series E modified lower case 32 after it ('65Em' is the height of the lower-case m itself, drawn 64.8: cap height 86.67), baseline 854, as drawn ('insert appropriate distance in metres e.g. 40'): 40 and 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 generated (Russell: the variants that make sense, not every value). Black, red and white on retroreflective yellow.
